analyst_view.overall: Early view: Villa arrive at Portman Road with Champions League football on their schedule and a defence that conceded seven in their last two games before the break. Ipswich, 14th under Gary O'Neil, lost 2-1 at home to Bournemouth. Amadou Onana remains out for Villa, and both sides play on 21 November first.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals, with Villa expected to score 1.8. I lean slightly higher: Villa conceded seven in two games while scoring four at Old Trafford, and Ipswich at home are likely to have a go at a defence that has been leaking.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners, split evenly. Villa rotating around Europe could tilt the ball toward Ipswich, but not by enough to move the total yet.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards. I lean slightly lower: Ipswich were booked only twice against Bournemouth, and Villa had a single booking in a frantic 4-4 at Old Trafford. Neither side has been collecting cards lately.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.7 shots. Villa's away games in a busy week can go either way, and Ipswich's attack has a goal threat in Jack Clarke, so I keep the site's figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.6 shots on target, which looks fair. Both attacks have been finding the net, Villa at Old Trafford and Ipswich through Clarke, so I do not move.
